+# ROLE M — mechanism declaration
+
+## Status: WITHDRAWN
+
+I cannot responsibly nominate a candidate under this protocol from the artifacts available in this
+workspace. This is a withdrawal, not a claim that all possible mechanisms are refuted. In particular,
+I will not invent an occurrence rate or imply that the frozen-artifact frequency has been measured.
+
+## Frozen protocol
+
+No change is proposed to the 32-dimensional latent, three 256-entry codebooks, three integer SID
+tokens, dataset/splits, or Stage2/Stage3 recipes. The required strict gates remain Hard-L1 ER >
+16.38953942232631, Stage3 Recall@10 > 0.06406796775709883, and NDCG@10 > 0.03530651701940677.
+
+## OPERATOR
+
+None. There is no formula, domain, curvature, basepoint, or tangent-space interpretation to declare.
+Naming an operator without establishing its common triggering configuration from the frozen artifacts
+would violate requirement 6c.
+
+## FINITE-PRECISION DEFINITION
+
+Not applicable: no operator is proposed. Consequently no epsilon, clamp, comparison tolerance, or
+boundary rule is being left for an implementation to decide.
+
+## GRADIENT PATH
+
+None. No gradients, stop-gradient boundaries, or changed loss terms are proposed.
+
+## INVARIANTS THAT FAIL FOR THE IDENTITY
+
+None claimed. Without a fully specified non-identity operator, asserting a broken identity invariant
+would be unsupported.
+
+## PRE-REGISTERED FALSIFIERS WITH NUMBERS
+
+No candidate-specific falsifier is registered. The unchanged acceptance gates are the three strict
+thresholds above; passing any subset is insufficient. The required frozen-artifact occurrence-rate
+number is **unavailable**, not zero: this workspace contains only its `opencode.json`, and does not
+contain the assignment stream / frozen Stage2 artifacts needed to compute a denominator and numerator.
+I therefore cannot establish that the acted-on configuration is common, as required.
+
+## CAPACITY STATEMENT
+
+No learned parameters are added. No layout change or frame transport is proposed. This is a declaration
+of non-proposal, not a candidate capacity claim.
+
+## WHY NOT THE SIX CLOSED FAMILIES
+
+No closed family is revived or repackaged. This document does not propose product-geodesic level-0
+radius assignment, horospheric/Busemann level sets, codeword-frame transported residuals,
+role-assigned token layout, gyro/Möbius associator scoring, unsigned tangent wedge area, or LOTV tie-break.
+In particular, it does not propose any rare-configuration-only tie-break without a prior rate audit.
+
+## WHY NOT HiHPQ (arXiv 2401.07212, abstract-only)
+
+No novelty or non-overlap claim against HiHPQ is made. The supplied evidence is abstract-only, and no
+candidate operator exists here to compare. An abstract-only citation cannot substitute for an
+operator-level comparison.
+
+## AUDIT
+
+No run should be launched from this declaration. To make a later proposal auditable, first provide the
+frozen assignment stream (including item/sequence identifiers and all three level assignments), the
+frozen Stage2 embeddings/codebooks and their numeric format, plus the exact artifact manifest/checksums.
+The pre-proposal audit must emit the event predicate, numerator, denominator, rate, aggregation rule,
+and deterministic tie/boundary handling so the frequency can be recomputed without training. Only after
+that rate is reported should a candidate be declared; its run must additionally emit every operator
+operand and intermediate needed to reproduce decisions, gradients, and all three evaluation metrics.
+
+**Decision:** WITHDRAWN pending frozen-artifact evidence sufficient to calculate a common-configuration
+rate. No performance claim is made.
*** End Patch
